verdict.rationale: BigQuery docs say it supports open table formats including Apache Iceberg, Delta, and Apache Hudi. Iceberg managed tables keep data in customer-owned storage buckets and share a single copy with third-party engines. A community user also confirms BigQuery external tables query data in object storage, comparing them to Athena over S3. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of querying raw Parquet files, first-party docs detailing external/BigLake tables that query Delta in place without loading, and hands-on corroboration beyond one brief community comparison.
